issues.description: The UML/problem statement specifies a Stock method named emptyStock(): void, but the template repository implements the same concept under a different name (clearInventory(): void). Students following the specification may look for/implement emptyStock(), while the starter code provides clearInventory(), causing confusion and potential compilation/test failures if tests call emptyStock().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the specification by renaming clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add an emptyStock() method that delegates to clearInventory() (and optionally remove/avoid the alternate name to keep a single canonical API).
